remarks: Immaculate 5-Bedroom Home in a Prime Norwalk Neighborhood! This beautifully maintained home in a quiet, sought-after neighborhood offers the perfect blend of space, comfort, and convenience. With five spacious bedrooms and two full and two half baths, there's plenty of room to spread out. Need a home office, Zoom room, or study space? You've got options! Gleaming hardwood and engineered flooring run throughout, while the fully finished basement with an electric fireplace creates a cozy retreat. The modern kitchen features stainless steel appliances and glass tile accents, and the updated bathrooms add a fresh, contemporary touch. Situated on a large corner lot with minimal traffic, the fenced-in yard provides privacy and a perfect outdoor space for relaxing, entertaining, or play. A rare opportunity to rent a home that truly shines inside and out!
